objective: Execute the supervisor's ordered F5c diagnostics: first the zero compute inlet development audit against the Driver and Seegmiller boundary layer thickness at the step, then, only if the inlet is clean, one unsteady probe run to test whether the reattachment region is genuinely unsteady, so the recorded 4 to 12 times reattachment error gets a named cause
rationale: F5c is the diagnosed open entry on the owner's challenge slate: converged steady solves land reattachment between 0.49 and 1.49 step heights against the reference 6.26 plus or minus 0.10, wandering non monotonically with iteration count while residuals converge cleanly to between 1e-5 and 1e-9. The old OOM premise is refuted in our own record and must not be carried forward. The supervisor's negative verdict review of 2026-08-07 orders two diagnostics by cost and this filing carries both in that order with the review's wording binding: first an inlet development audit at zero core minutes, because the reference experiment has a developed boundary layer of stated thickness at the step, the classic backward facing step trap is an inlet that does not reproduce it, and the 4 to 12 times magnitude smells like exactly that; then, only if the inlet is clean, one unsteady probe run at about 25 core minutes, because a steady solver on a flow with a genuinely unsteady reattachment region wanders exactly as recorded. Before either step, the slate's own zero cost check runs first: re verify the step height nondimensionalisation in the post processing, since a metric bug explains an error of this size more often than physics does, and two lessons in the record are exactly that failure. Prediction, written before any field is read: the inlet audit fails, the boundary layer thickness at the step will not match the reference within its stated tolerance, because nothing in the case's construction history ever set it. Axis A: 3.0 gain points over 25 core minutes. Axis B: none directly; a later passing rung improves the step family's standing. Axis C: zero, no scored column moves
gate: Ordered and conditional, declared before any field is read. Step zero: the nondimensionalisation check either clears the post processing or ends the item with the cause named at zero core minutes. Step one: measure boundary layer thickness over step height at the step from the existing converged fields and compare against the reference value at the experiment's stated tolerance; if it fails, the cause is assigned to the inlet, the probe run is not spent, and the successor filing is the inlet repair with its own prediction. Step two, only if step one is clean: the unsteady probe runs with reattachment location probes; MECHANISM CONFIRMED if the instantaneous reattachment point fluctuates with a band comparable to the recorded steady wander, MECHANISM REFUTED if it settles to a steady value, and either verdict is a result. If both the inlet and the unsteadiness come back clean, the discrepancy escalates rather than being rediagnosed on a hunch
cost_basis: the nondimensionalisation check and the inlet audit read existing fields and cost zero; the 25 prices the single unsteady probe run, sized against the six existing step runs measured at 26.9 core minutes total at the same resolutions, and matches the supervisor's own figure of about 25
expected_knowledge_gain: Every branch changes a decision. An inlet failure names the cause of a 4 to 12 times error at zero compute and converts the family's next spend from diagnosis to repair. A confirmed unsteady mechanism refuses steady gating for this family and routes it to the unsteady statistics line, which is the criterion it would then be graded under. A refuted mechanism with a clean inlet eliminates both supervisor candidates and forces the escalation the charter prefers to a coin flip. A metric bug caught at step zero ends a two session mystery for free
